results.question: Trong các campaign 2022, campaign nào có net sales gắn tag cao nhất trong thời gian chạy?

citations.title: Commerce SQL aggregate: Promotion planning
citations.excerpt: question_specific_query question-specific SQL observations: [{"net_sales": "117313096.22", "promo_id": "PROMO-0047", "promo_name": "Spring Sale 2022"}, {"net_sales": "72106194.48", "promo_id": "PROMO-0049", "promo_name": "Fall Launch 2022"}, {"net_sales": "69949698.58", "promo_id": "PROMO-0048", "promo_name": "Mid-Year Sale 2022"}, {"net_sales": "56582969.36", "promo_id": "PROMO-0050", "promo_name": "Year-End Sale 2022"}]
citations.sql_query: SELECT p.promo_id, p.promo_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_sales FROM commerce.promotions AS p INNER JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.promo_id = p.promo_id INNER JOIN commerce.orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) = 2022 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date) = 2022 GROUP BY p.promo_id, p.promo_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC LIMIT 100
citations.dataset_note: Synthetic Kaggle Datathon 2026 Round 1 Commerce data; not observed results from a real retailer.
